milestones.note: Basic and Core Skill; energy management is the hardest part here. Phase = Early Game (Levels 1-19).
A far superior option replacing Combo Points for superior Energy economy.
Mobility tools to reposition for optimal blade returns.
Shadow Imbuement is an AoE tool for groups; Poison Imbuement for bosses/elites.
Most key synergies are unlocked; remaining points fill skill ranks on primary abilities.

strategy: Prioritize upgrading melee weapons while using high mobility through Dash and Shadow Step to maximize Twisting Blades' returning-blade damage. Once Inner Sight unlocks at level 20, energy management becomes manageable, allowing Shadow Imbuement for groups and Poison Imbuement for tough single targets through level 70.

paragon.note: Maxroll has not published a separate endgame/Paragon guide for this build - only the leveling guide exists, so no Paragon board or glyph data is available.
